_about: Rows (by id) whose stored range_mi is knowingly not an EPA figure. The watch script lists them as accepted instead of flagging them. Remove an entry once EPA rates the trim.

range_mi.lucid-gravity-2027-gt-s: Lucid projection; EPA has not rated the GT-S.
range_mi.lexus-tz-2027-premium-touring-awd: Lexus estimate; EPA has rated only the Premium so far.
range_mi.lexus-tz-2027-luxury-awd: Lexus estimate; EPA has rated only the Premium so far.
range_mi.tesla-model-x-2021-plaid-5s: Tesla's figure for the refreshed 2021 Plaid; EPA's 2021 file has no Plaid entry.
range_mi.tesla-model-x-2021-plaid-6s: Tesla's figure for the refreshed 2021 Plaid; EPA's 2021 file has no Plaid entry.
range_mi.tesla-model-x-2021-plaid-7s: Tesla's figure for the refreshed 2021 Plaid; EPA's 2021 file has no Plaid entry.
range_mi.vinfast-vf9-2025-eco: EPA's 2024 VF 9 Eco rating (330 mi); EPA's 2025 file lists only the Plus.
